ModMetaData.name: Cerean Mane South Fix — Outer Rim: Galactic Diversity
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Restores the south-facing art of the "cerean mane" hairstyle in Outer Rim - Galactic Diversity.
The file is not missing. It ships, it loads without complaint, and it is completely empty: 512x512 pixels of which zero have any alpha at all. A Cerean wearing this hairstyle therefore renders BALD from the front — the facing you see most of the time — while the north and east views are fine. No log line is possible: "Failed to find any textures at" fires only when EVERY direction of a Graphic_Multi is absent, and a present-but-transparent PNG is a completely successful load by every measure the engine has. It was found by decoding the alpha channel, not by reading a log.
No defs are patched, no code runs, and Outer Rim - Galactic Diversity is not altered. This mod drops one loose PNG at the path the donor's own HairDef already asks for.
CONTENTS
OuterRim/Hairs/Cerean/CereanMane_south The front view of the Cerean mane crest. 512x512, 14,660 bytes, 5.68% of the canvas inked.
THE DONOR'S ORIGINAL: present, 512x512, 1,514 bytes, alpha maximum 0 — 0 of 262,144 pixels carry any opacity. Its siblings are healthy for comparison: CereanMane_north is 13,060 bytes at 7.19% coverage and CereanMane_east is 11,809 bytes at 5.43%. Every other Cerean hairstyle in the mod — Long, Pony, Tuft — ships three sound facings, so this is one broken file, not a broken set.
HOW OURS WAS BUILT AND VERIFIED: drawn to the donor's own measured conventions rather than to taste — 512x512 RGBA, a pure black keyline 11 px wide (measured on CereanMane_north at row y=300), and a vertical greyscale fill running 247 at y=120 down to 181 at y=300. Registration was derived from the mod's own healthy pairs: in every sound Cerean set the south view shares the north's x-range and top edge and is shorter, so this one is pinned to CereanMane_north's bounding box, x 195-317 with its top at y=92. The generator is shipped in Source/draw_mane_south.py.
WHERE THE DEF IS
Outer Rim - Galactic Diversity's own HairDef asks for this exact path:
1.6/Defs/HairDefs/Hairs_Cerean.xml line 37 defName OuterRim_CereanMane line 39 texPath OuterRim/Hairs/Cerean/CereanMane
NO LOAD ORDER REQUIREMENT — AND THAT IS DELIBERATE
This mod deliberately declares no loadAfter, because it does not need one.
On 1.6 Outer Rim - Galactic Diversity serves its art from an AssetBundle, not from loose files. Its LoadFolders.xml swaps the v1.4/v1.5 "Common_Old" folder for "Common" under v1.6, and Common/ holds nothing but AssetBundles/neronix17_outerrim_galacticdiversity. The loose Cerean PNGs that still sit in Common_Old are simply not loaded on this game version.
RimWorld resolves a texture as loose file in any active mod FIRST, then base game resources, then AssetBundles — so a loose PNG beats a bundled asset regardless of which mod loads first. Ordering this mod would buy nothing.
The defect does survive the bundling, which is the thing worth checking rather than assuming: the bundle manifest lists GalacticDiversity/Textures/OuterRim/Hairs/Cerean/CereanMane_south as an entry, so the empty texture is inside the bundle too and is what the game draws today.
If Outer Rim - Galactic Diversity ever ships real art at this path, this mod would still win by being loose, so unsubscribe it at that point.
